findings.claim: FY2025 前五大 OEM 客戶占淨銷售約 44%（2024 年 42%、2023 年 41%），兩家客戶合計占 23%。
findings.excerpt: Our five largest OEM customers collectively accounted for approximately 44%, 42%, and 41% of our net sales for the years ended December 29, 2025, December 30, 2024, and January 1, 2024, respectively, and two customers collectively represented 23% of our net sales for the year ended December 29, 2025.
Sales to our ten largest customers collectively accounted for 55%, 42%, and 41% of our net sales in 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.

findings.claim: 2025 年底有一家客戶占應收帳款 14%；2024 年底無客戶達 10%。公司不要求擔保品。
findings.excerpt: As of December 29, 2025, one customer accounted for 14% of the Company's accounts receivable. There were no customers that accounted for 10% or more of the Company's accounts receivable as of December 30, 2024.

findings.claim: 公司稱客戶逾 1,300 家，前十大客戶合作關係均逾十年。
findings.excerpt: Our sales are diversified across end markets with over 1,300 customers and long-term relationships exceeding ten years with our ten largest customers, which reduces our exposure to any single end market or customer.

note: 單次搜尋未找到前幾大客戶的信用評等降級、破產或指引下修等 2026 年事件；10-K 未具名客戶。
